# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 31 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 37 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_031_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 31

**1** Jesus said: "No prophet [профнтнс] is accepted [шелеет] in his own village [тефшоме].

**2** No physician [сав] heals [талчо] those who know him."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *профнтнс*: prophet; Greek loan-word
- *шелеет*: to receive, accept, welcome
- *тефшоме*: his village, hometown, native place
- *сав*: physician, healer; also "wise one/master" (cf. Thomas's use in Saying 13)
- cf. P.Oxy 1 lines 21-26 for Greek parallel
- cf. Luke 4:23-24; Matt 13:57; Mark 6:4; John 4:44 — the prophet-without-honor saying
- Thomas's v.2 (physician who heals) has no exact Synoptic parallel; cf. Luke 4:23 ("Physician, heal yourself")
